message.reasoning_content: We need to determine appropriate charge(s) based on facts: The defendant set fire to grass in his field, causing fire that burned mango seedlings (non-forest land). The area is 9.6 hectares (144.5 mu) of un-forested land, seedlings 10065, value 75,279 yuan. He did not have approval from forestry department. This is arson? In Chinese criminal law, "放火" (arson) is the crime of setting fire to forest, grassland, etc. There's also "失火" (unintentional fire) but here it's intentional: he used a lighter to ignite grass. So the charge is "放火". However there is also "伐林木" (illegal logging) but not applicable. "非法占用农用地" not. The act is intentional fire causing damage to forest resources. The list includes "放火". Also "失火" appears in examples for accidental fire. Here it's intentional, so "放火". Also maybe "伐林木"? No, he didn't cut trees. So answer: [罪名]放火<eoa>.
